title: A run's report lists the bugs it filed and the gates it added from the runner worktree, so a bug filed and landed through the code lane is missing from runner-status and the digest
goal: autopilot.gates_of_run and autopilot.bugs_filed read the sprint's item files at autopilot.integration_tip (the integration main the run landed on), the same tip landed_items counts to, and not from the runner worktree's HEAD and working tree, so a bug a worker files and lands through a code/<id> merge request, and a gate it adds, appear in the run report (runner-status) and the digest; a planted test has the bug's item file and the gate only on the integration main and finds both, and a blocked run finds none; found by BG-rgdrjsz6, which fixed the landed count the same way.

run: import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import autopilot as a;sys.exit(0 if all('tip' in inspect.signature(f).parameters for f in (a.bugs_filed,a.gates_of_run)) else 1)

repro_reason: the miss shows only for a bug filed and landed through the code lane, which only the new test plants; the repro checks that both readers take the integration tip
